name: rohan20k/Credit_Card_Approval_Predictor
description: I have created this project to explore my curiosity and to get a taste of how commercial banks 🏦 accept or reject applications requesting credit cards. Times have changed and today, commercial banks receive a lot of applications for credit cards. At my bank branch, I had inquired as to why credit card applications are rejected and I was provided with a couple of potential reasons like an unusually high number of inquiries on an individual's credit report, high loan balances, and low-income balances to name a few.
